note: 'These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.' (Col 4:11); the letter names Paul as its writer at Col 1:1.
'Lot had reached Zoar' (Gen 19:23), and 'Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain ... for he feared to dwell in Zoar' (Gen 19:30).
